name: TS Apartment, Yerevan, second floor (traced)
note: Duplex: only the second (attic) floor is in the cached plan (1280 x 759 px, evals/real/fetch.ts) and only it is traced; the stair down is a room named Stair. Scale from the plan's 0-5 m bar (332 px for 5 m = 66.4 px/m; kitchen counter 0.6 m deep and WC door 0.75 m agree). No printed areas (published 110 m2 is both floors). Thick masonry walls at inner faces, partitions on centre lines; the small wall jogs (niche left of the kitchen, the slanted wall at the bedroom's south-east corner) squared off; the bay at the living room's south-west (glazing at x 277-282) cut at the glazing. Terrace left out; its two folding glass doors kept as doors. The bedroom's folding partition is a wall with two wide doors (2.0 and 0.9 m). The hatched landing below the stair is in the living room; the Stair is open on its south side. The radiator-like mark on the bedroom's south wall is taken as a window. Kitchen as drawn: one straight run on the north wall with hob and sink.
